sources.location: deposited SMPL_NFO.xlsx (RAW file → patient, tumour type PT/LR, age at diagnosis)

claims.value: 27 patients × primary tumour + ipsilateral local recurrence; age from AGE.DIAGNOSIS (floored)
claims.evidence: SMPL_NFO.xlsx maps each RAW file to patient and PT/LR
Methods and PRIDE protocol text say Q Exactive HFX; the PRIDE instrument field says Q Exactive HF — the text is followed

claims.value: grade 1–3 / not available; ER, PgR, HER2/ERBB2 score, TP53 per tumour; adjuvant therapy after primary surgery per patient
claims.evidence: SMPL_NFO.xlsx columns TUMOR.GRADE, ER, PgR, Her2/ERBB2, TP53 per RAW file; RADIOTHERAPY/ENDOCRINE.THERAPY/CHEMOTHERAPY (given on the PT row only) are the adjuvant treatments of Table 1 and are written on both tumours of the patient
breast cancer patients with ipsilateral recurrence after breast-conserving surgery; no male patient is described (inferred)
Methods: trypsin 1:50, 37 °C 16 h; the PRIDE sample protocol also names trypsin (the reconcile flag reads only the structured PRIDE fields)

limitations: comment[modification parameters] = Carbamidomethyl C (fixed) only, from the iodoacetamide step; no variable modifications are stated in the paper or PRIDE (the PX submission says no PTMs are included), and the deposited PQP library was not parsed.

Adjuvant therapy flags appear only on the primary-tumour rows of SMPL_NFO.xlsx; they describe treatment after primary surgery and are carried on both the PT and LR rows of that patient. TUMOR.SIZE and lymph-node counts are not annotated because the size unit is not stated.

Ki-67 (MKI67 high/low) is not annotated: the spreadsheet counts are the exact reverse of paper Table 1 (PT high 10 / low 13, LR high 8 / low 16 vs Table 1 with the labels swapped). Grade also differs by one recurrence (12 grade-2 LR in the sheet vs 13 in Table 1); the sheet is followed.
sex = female is inferred from the cohort description (breast cancer, breast-conserving surgery); SMPL_NFO.xlsx has no sex column.
dia-acquisition template not declared (its validator requires the bare literal instead of NT=/AC=).
